title: From Mind Mapping to Dream Interpretation: Understanding Muslim Users’ Engagement with GenAI Tools in Religious Context

bias_targets.methodology: Reflexive thematic analysis of online survey responses and user prompts to identify Muslim users' perceived concerns regarding the misrepresentation of Islamic values, marginalization of Islam, and suppression of specific Islamic schools of thought.
Qualitative analysis of open-ended survey responses highlighting participants' concerns about inherent Western bias and the tools reflecting the cultural worldviews of their creators.
Thematic analysis of user feedback capturing concerns that GenAI tools exhibit overly liberal views or political ideologies when answering queries in a religious context.
